title: X-Men
synopsis: Rogue runs away after discovering the danger of her touch. Xavier offers her a place to learn while Magneto wants to use her power for his machine.
verdictRationale: Two people put their hands on Rogue with very different intentions. Magneto makes her bear a danger he could face himself. Logan accepts the cost of healing her. The rescue gives the story its moral center.
ageRationale: A child is separated from his parents at a concentration camp. Later a teenager is strapped into a machine. Families may need time to discuss both kinds of terror.
reflection: Rogue has come to fear even an ordinary touch. Logan’s decision to reach for her makes a tender question possible for families. Who has begun to expect rejection, and how could we make it safe for them to come close?

title: X2
synopsis: An attack on the president becomes the pretext for a raid on Xavier’s school. The adults have to protect the children while uncovering who controlled the attacker.
verdictRationale: Nightcrawler’s prayer and Jean’s rescue of her companions give families examples of faith and courage. The sexualized drugging of a guard and the spectacle of bodies being used as weapons temper the recommendation.
ageRationale: A guard is drugged during a sexual advance and later dies violently. A child is hit with a dart during the school raid, and liquid metal emerges from a dying woman’s face.
reflection: When Storm and Jean find Nightcrawler in a cathedral, they meet a man trying to understand what was done through him. Listening to his account is an act of justice. Families can ask whom they have judged from the most frightening thing they saw.

title: X-Men: The Last Stand
synopsis: A treatment that suppresses mutant powers divides Xavier’s students. Meanwhile Jean returns with destructive powers that place her friends in danger.
verdictRationale: Angel uses his wings to save the father who wanted them gone. That act of mercy matters alongside harder questions about Xavier’s control over Jean’s mind and Logan’s lethal response to her plea.
ageRationale: Phoenix begins to undress Logan in an intense sexual encounter. People disintegrate on screen, and Logan kills someone he loves at close range.
reflection: Angel could let his father fall. Instead he closes the distance between them with the very wings his father rejected. In an Orthodox family this can open a conversation about mercy while the work of rebuilding trust is still ahead.
